problem: A readiness refusal could consume the response budget, discard the terminal write error, and propagate out of the required audit listener.
implementation: Reserve two seconds from initial readiness admission within the existing fifteen-second response lifecycle; retained cleanup may exceed that admission budget and is never falsely treated as settled.
Distinct server-facing Prepared/Refused outcome preserves the existing discovery Result channel.
Recoverable refusal requires no created owner or exact owner removal, stop signal and successful inner task join after checked discovery teardown.
Monitor join, complete framed503 write and close must succeed before the listener continues. Missing owner, task/join failure, cancellation, deadline and terminal delivery uncertainty remain fatal.
